name: roveliese-vsc
description: Atmospheric rose theme for VS Code

roveliese.accentColor.markdownDescription: **Start here.** Changes badges, the progress bar, focus indicators, and picker borders. `mauve` is the balanced default; buttons stay rose.

roveliese.italicKeywords.markdownDescription: Italicizes language keywords such as `return`, `class`, and `function`. Try it with #roveliese.boldKeywords# for stronger landmarks in dense code.

roveliese.boldKeywords.markdownDescription: Bolds language keywords such as `return`, `class`, and `function`. A simple way to make code structure easier to scan.

roveliese.italicComments.markdownDescription: Renders comments in italic. Enabled by default as part of the intended Roveliese appearance.

enumDescriptions: Full three-shade chrome: sidebar, tabs, and editor have distinct backgrounds.
Reduced contrast: sidebar background matches the editor background.
Single-shade: sidebar, tabs, and panels all use the editor background.
roveliese.workbenchMode.markdownDescription: Controls how distinct the VS Code chrome is from the editor. Keep `default` for the complete theme; try `minimal` when you want the editor to recede into the background.

enumDescriptions: All brackets use the foreground color (current default).
Brackets use progressively dimmed shades of the foreground.
Six distinct palette colors cycle across bracket depth levels.
roveliese.bracketColors.markdownDescription: Choose how nested brackets communicate depth. `monochromatic` is quiet; `rainbow` is the easiest to scan in deeply nested code.

enumDescriptions: Quiet navigation chrome matching the default Roveliese atmosphere.
More visible scrollbars, tree and indent guides, and ignored Git decorations.
roveliese.navigationContrast.markdownDescription: Controls scrollbars, tree and indent guides, and ignored Git decorations without changing syntax highlighting. Choose `clear` if navigation details are too subtle.

roveliese.indent.enabled.markdownDescription: Highlights indentation levels with colors matched to the active Roveliese theme. Enabled by default; disable only if another indent-guide extension already does this.

enumDescriptions: Thin vertical line on the left edge of each indent level.
Colored background fill across the full indent region.
roveliese.indent.style.markdownDescription: Choose `line` for a quiet 1 px guide, or `background` for stronger structural cues. See #roveliese.indent.opacity# to tune the strength.

roveliese.indent.opacity.markdownDescription: Opacity for indent highlights (`5`–`100`). Leave empty for the tuned per-theme default. Example: `16` keeps the `background` style intentionally subtle.

roveliese.indent.lineWidth.markdownDescription: Width in pixels for the `line` style. Keep `1` for the intended subtle guide; try `2` when guides need to be easier to see.

scripts.check:all: npm test && npm run build:check && npm run verify && npm run verify:all && npm run verify:roles && npm run verify:generated
scripts.release:prepare: npm run build && npm run build:ext && npm run check:all
scripts.test: node --require ts-node/register --test src/test/overrides.test.ts src/test/roles.test.ts src/test/colorMath.test.ts src/test/themeDiff.test.ts src/test/verifiers.test.ts
